g.text: CYCLOHEXANE REACTOR VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
CYCLOHEXANE UNIT — BENZENE HYDROGENATION REACTOR TRAIN
Benzene 34.8 t/h; product 37.5 t/h, 2 ppm benzene
1. Rev 0 · Issued for teaching. Flags: t/h, °C, bar g at the design point.
2. All numbers come from the simulator model (design state, noise off); no flag = no model value.
3. H2 passes R-101, E-103/V-103, R-102, R-103, V-104 and K-101 in series; D-101 blowdown (≈1 %) not shown.
